Job Summary  
The PSAD – A&D team is on the lookout for a Senior Management Trainee (Proposal Management & Presales) with strong engineering and technology acumen, sharp analytical thinking and business writing skills an ability to translate engineering solutions into winning proposals, bringing out the best in their talented and high-performing team. As a Senior Management Trainee, you are responsible for supporting the end-to-end bid lifecycle and account management activities. 
Key Responsibilities  
 Support end-to-end RFP / RFI / RFQ response management for large aerospace and defense engineering pursuits — from qualification and solution structuring through submission, clarifications, orals, and BAFO. 
 Collaborate with solution architects, SMEs, and delivery leaders to develop technically accurate, differentiated, and win-themed responses across engineering domains such as PLM, MES, mechanical & structures, embedded systems, hardware & electronics, aftermarket & MRO, digital thread, and manufacturing engineering. 
 Build and maintain the compliance matrix, cross-reference customer requirements, and ensure 100% traceability between the RFP asks and HCLTech’s response. 
 Support the development of commercial models — Basic knowledge about various pricing models like: T&M, Firm Fixed Price (FPP), outcome-based / gain-share, catalogue pricing, etc. 
 Coordinate internal approval workflows and track legal document execution. 
 Draft GTM decks, executive summaries, leadership briefing decks, capability slides, case studies, and win-theme narratives tailored to A&D customers. 
 Support customer visits, orals, and workshops at HCLTech engineering centers (Chennai, Bengaluru) with high-quality collateral and demo storyboards. 
 Maintain the reusable knowledge repository — case studies and capability decks, 
 Track pursuit dashboards, submission timelines, action items, and follow-ups; publish crisp status updates to leadership. 
 Continuously scan the aerospace and defense ecosystem — platforms, OEMs, tier-1 suppliers, analyst rankings, and technology trends (AI/ML in engineering, digital twin, model-based engineering, sustainable aviation, eVTOL/UAM) — and translate insights into pursuit strategy. 
 Ensure regular and effective communication across cross-functional pursuit teams; act as the single point of coordination for RFP asks, clarifications, and follow-ups. 
 Plan and drive submission timelines, review cadences, and post-submission follow-throughs across the pursuit lifecycle. 
Skill Requirements  
 Strong engineering and technology acumen — able to quickly grasp technical concepts across mechanical, electrical, electronics, embedded, software, and digital engineering domains. 
 Excellent business writing skills — able to draft crisp, error-free executive summaries, compliance responses, and customer-facing narratives. 
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Word, and Excel (formulas, pivots, financial modeling) 
 You show resilience when faced with challenges and remain calm under high-pressure submission timelines; you believe in continuous learning and growth and possess a strong work ethic. 
 You are collaborative, culturally aware, and enjoy working with colleagues and customers across the globe. 
 You are passionate about innovation, curious about emerging technologies (AI/ML, digital twin, generative design, sustainable aviation, autonomous systems), and want to make an impact in the aerospace and defense industry. 
Other Requirements  
NA

Job Summary  
We are looking for enthusiastic and technically sound Designer – Analog Layout Design candidates who have completed formal training or internship programs in VLSI Analog Layout Design. The candidate will work under the guidance of experienced layout engineers and contribute to the physical implementation of Analog, Mixed-Signal, and Custom Layout blocks. 
The role offers an excellent opportunity to learn industry-standard design methodologies, semiconductor process technologies, physical verification flows, and advanced layout implementation techniques while working on real customer projects and product development programs. Training programs within the organization emphasize CMOS fundamentals, IC fabrication, Cadence-based Analog Layout Design, and project-oriented learning. 
Key Responsibilities  
 Analog Layout Implementation 
Support the creation of custom layouts for analog and mixed-signal circuits. 
Assist in layout development for: 
Amplifiers 
Current Mirrors 
Comparators 
LDOs 
Bandgap Circuits 
Level Shifters 
Oscillators 
DACs 
Analog Sub-blocks 
Learn and apply standard analog layout methodologies during implementation activities. Experience summaries from junior layout engineers indicate exposure to blocks such as OPAMPs, current mirrors, level shifters, LDOs, and amplifiers as part of early-career responsibilities. 
 Floorplanning & Routing 
Support floorplanning activities based on design constraints. 
Perform device placement and routing under technical supervision. 
Learn routing techniques for analog signal integrity, shielding, and power distribution. 
Gain understanding of area optimization and layout quality requirements. Entry-level layout profiles reference floorplanning, placement, routing, and top-level integration activities.
 Physical Verification 
Perform basic physical verification checks including: 
DRC 
LVS 
Antenna Checks 
Density Checks 
Analyze and fix verification violations with guidance from senior engineers. 
Understand verification sign-off criteria and layout quality requirements. Verification activities such as DRC, LVS, density checks, and related quality checks are identified as foundational responsibilities in internal layout profiles and training material. 
 Design Quality & Learning 
Learn layout best practices including: 
Device Matching 
Common Centroid Structures 
Symmetry 
Guard Rings 
Shielding 
Develop understanding of semiconductor manufacturing constraints and layout-dependent effects. 
Participate in technical reviews, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities. Internal training programs specifically emphasize CMOS fundamentals, fabrication concepts, and Analog Layout Design practices. 
 Team Collaboration 
Work closely with layout engineers, circuit designers, and technical leads. 
Participate in project discussions and review meetings. 
Support project execution activities while adhering to quality and schedule commitments. 
Skill Requirements  
 Mandatory Skills 
Understanding of Analog and Mixed-Signal circuit fundamentals. 
Basic knowledge of: 
CMOS Devices 
Semiconductor Fabrication 
Electronic Circuits 
Layout Design Concepts 
Exposure to: 
Floorplanning 
Device Placement 
Routing 
Physical Verification 
Good understanding of analog layout concepts such as: 
Matching 
Symmetry 
Shielding 
Guard Rings 
Strong willingness to learn and adapt to customer-specific methodologies. Internal Analog Layout training programs emphasize CMOS fundamentals, fabrication knowledge, geometric aptitude, and Analog Layout Design using Cadence flow. 
 Preferred Skills 
Internship or training project experience involving: 
Analog Layout Design 
Custom Layout Design 
Mixed-Signal Layout Design 
Exposure to advanced technology nodes through training projects. 
Basic scripting knowledge is an added advantage. Automation exposure through SKILL, Shell, and scripting forms part of internal training curricula. 
 EDA Tools Exposure 
Candidates should have academic, internship, or training exposure to one or more of the following: 
Cadence Virtuoso 
Calibre 
Assura 
PVS 
Layout Verification Tools 
Other Requirements  
Cadence-based Analog Layout Design and physical verification flows are specifically highlighted in internal training programs and engineer profiles. 
 Educational Qualification 
B.E. / B.Tech. in: 
Electronics & Communication Engineering 
Electrical & Electronics Engineering 
Electronics Engineering 
Instrumentation Engineering 
OR 
M.Tech. / M.E. in: 
VLSI Design 
Microelectronics 
Semiconductor Technology 
Embedded Systems

Job Summary  
 Job Title: AI Proposal Specialist E2.1 
 Job Location – Noida 
 About the Role: 
 The AI Proposal Specialist E2.1 role requires an experienced and forward-thinking individual to join the Integrated GTM team, supporting both Digital Business Services (DBS) and Engineering Services (ERS). The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving strategic deals and playing a key role in shaping next-generation solutions that harness cutting-edge technologies, including Generative AI (Gen AI), to deliver exceptional value to clients. 
 In this role, you’ll harness Gen AI to enable end-to-end service transformation, drive industry-aligned value chain innovation, and elevate process excellence—delivering intelligent, outcome-based solutions with measurable impact. You’ll collaborate with practice leaders and technical subject matter experts to identify market opportunities, craft compelling go-to-market (GTM) strategies, and develop persuasive pitches that showcase innovation in Gen AI-powered automation, advanced analytics, and AI-driven digital transformation. The role spans a diverse digital ecosystem, including UX & UI, digital engagement platforms, modern application development, multi-channel commerce, and cloud and application modernization. 
 As an E2, you will execute routine presales tasks independently, following established standards and processes. 
Key Responsibilities  
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Independently prepare standard responses and presentations. 
 Engage with clients to understand basic requirements. 
 Ensure technical accuracy in proposals. 
 Support outcome-based pricing constructs. 
 Maintain documentation and process compliance. 
Skill Requirements  
 Skills Needed: 
 Proficiency in standard presales tools and templates. 
 Good communication and organizational skills. 
 Ability to follow established processes and standards. 
 Basic understanding of AI’s role in digital transformation 
 Qualifications & Experience: 
 MBA 
 2–4 years of experience in presales or related fields. 
Other Requirements  
 Expectations for New Hires: 
 Complete AI certification and internal process training. 
 Familiarize with company platforms and tools. 
 Participate in team meetings and contribute to discussions. 
 What Will Happen in the First Six Weeks of Joining: 
 Week 1: AI and process training. 
 Weeks 2–4: Independently handle routine proposal tasks. 
 Weeks 5–6: Start managing small presales engagements.

Job Summary  
About the Role
We are seeking enthusiastic and highly motivated Fresher AIML Developer to join our innovative technology team. This role is designed for recent B. Tech graduates specializing in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Data Science. You will contribute to the entire lifecycle of our Software and AI products, from data collection and cleaning to model development, deployment, and monitoring. This is an excellent opportunity to apply your academic knowledge to real-world business challenges and grow into a skilled professional in the rapidly evolving field of AI. 
Key Responsibilities  
Key Responsibilities
•
Model Development and Training:
o
Work under supervision to implement, train, and validate various Machine Learning models (e.g., Regression, Classification, Clustering, Neural Networks), SLMs and LLMs
o
Assist in feature engineering and selection to improve model performance.
•
Coding and Implementation:
o
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code in Python for data processing and model implementation.
o
Collaborate with senior engineers to integrate models into production environments.
•
Evaluation and Reporting:
o
Perform rigorous model evaluation using relevant metrics and statistical analysis.
o
Document development processes, results, and findings clearly. 
Skill Requirements  
Required Qualifications & Skills (The Non-Negotiables)
•
Education: B. Tech/ master’s degree in a relevant field (CSE/IT/EC/AI/ML/DL)
2
•

•
Academic Performance: Strong academic record (mention a minimum required CGPA/percentage if applicable).
•
Programming Proficiency: Demonstrated hands-on experience and proficiency in Python (including libraries like NumPy, Pandas, Numba and Scikit-learn).
•
Core Concepts: Solid understanding of fundamental Operating Systems, Database Management System, Data Structures and Algorithms.
•
Database Knowledge: Basic proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation.
•
AIML Foundations: Strong theoretical understanding of key Machine Learning algorithms, Deep Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, statistical & probabilistic modeling, and data engineering + visualization techniques. 
Other Requirements  
Preferred Skills (The Value-Adds)
•
GenAI Frameworks: Hands-on with Langchain, Langgraph, LLAMAIndex, LangServe, ADK, Nemo, etc. Copilots, Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants

GenAI Skill: Prompt engineering, RAG, fine-tuning, and agentic workflows, Build end-to-end GenAI pipelines including data ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, inference, and feedback loops
•
Version Control: Experience with Git and GitHub for collaborative code development.
•
Cloud Exposure: Awareness of cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP) and their data/ML services along with MLOps/LLMOps
•
Project Experience: Completion of relevant academic projects, internships, or Kaggle competitions showcasing practical application of AIML skills.

Job Summary  
As a Graduate Trainee - Service Desk , responsible for providing first-level technical support to end users by diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and network-related issues. Acts as the initial point of contact for IT support requests, ensuring timely incident resolution and excellent customer service. Supports ticket management, troubleshooting, user account administration, and escalation of complex issues to relevant teams while adhering to service level agreements (SLAs). Continuously develops technical knowledge and contributes to maintaining a smooth and efficient IT support environment. 
Key Responsibilities  
Provide first-line IT support via phone, email, chat, or ticketing systems.Log, track, and resolve incidents and service requests in accordance with SLAs.Troubleshoot hardware, software, network, and application-related issues.Escalate unresolved issues to appropriate support teams and follow up until closure.Assist with user account management, password resets, and access requests.Maintain accurate documentation of incidents, solutions, and support procedures.Deliver high-quality customer service and ensure positive user experiences.Participate in knowledge-sharing and continuous improvement initiatives. 
Skill Requirements  
Basic understanding of operating systems, Microsoft 365, networking, and IT support processes.Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.Effective verbal and written communication skills.Customer-centric mindset with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
